name: vouchwell
description: Tamper-evident receipts for every tool call Claude Code makes: shell commands, file reads and edits, web fetches, MCP tools. A policy decides before each call runs; every call leaves a signed, hash-chained receipt anyone can verify offline.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: enforce: the policy can refuse a call or ask you first. monitor: record everything, block nothing. off: do nothing. A project with its own vouchwell.config.json uses that instead.

log_dir.title: Log folder
log_dir.description: Where receipts are kept for projects without their own Vouchwell config. Empty means ~/.vouchwell/claude-code.

policy.title: Policy file
policy.description: A Vouchwell policy to use instead of the bundled one (coding-agent + shell-safety). Make one with: vw policy template <ids> --out <file>
